jobs.description:
À propos

Mercateam Has Proven In The Last 4 Years Its Aptitude To Bring a Bright Answer To New Big Challenges Faced By The Industry

an aging workforce;
a high turnover;
increasingly sophisticated and technological machines and data proliferation;

which are changing the composition of the manufacturing labor force and how work gets done.

As a result, manufacturers face an urgent imperative to help less experienced workers build knowledge and capabilities, and take advantage of data through collaboration.

Mercateam has built its solution hand in hand with top manufacturers to bring employees into Industry 4.0 and bridge the gap between investments made in machines and in operational workforce and its development.

We have developed a SaaS solution based on the latest technologies for mapping skills on production sites and organize know-how.

This has led to a number of other key features managed by Mercateam, including:

smart planning of work assignments under constraints;
a training module adapted to the operational workforce;
a workforce strategic planning.

Mercateam had a strong commercial track record in the last 3 years and supports over 150 industrial sites, among which LVMH, Andros, Richemond, Dior, LISI, Collins Aerospace, etc… in 12 different countries, with his 360 industrial workforce-centric solution.

Mercateam’s ambition is to become the European leader in blue-collar management over the next three years.

Descriptif du poste

Mercateam is the platform manufacturers use to digitalize their industrial know-how (skills, certifications, training, workforce planning) and turn it into measurable operational performance on the shop floor. Every month, dozens of top industrial sites go live with us. We're scaling fast and moving to an AI-native platform, where deployment plays a central role: we don't just hand over a project, we build and prove the value our clients get.

You'll join a tight-knit deployment team (4 consultants + 1 technical PM), hands-on, supportive and ambitious.

The role: Senior Implementation Consultant / Project Manager
(evolving toward Forward Deployed Engineer)

You'll lead our most complex, multi-site deployments end to end, and grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer profile, contributing your expertise to build the technical and AI muscle that makes deployments faster and more scalable.

What you'll do

Consulting & delivery
Lead complex, multi-site deployments end to end: analyze client processes (as-is to to-be), train users on Mercateam, secure go-live, then hand over to Customer Success.
Run on-site workshops in plants to frame high-value use cases and set the KPI baseline and target outcomes.
Support clients as they restructure and evolve their know-how management processes (change management).
Turn field learnings into reusable playbooks.
Technical configuration
Configure the platform and integrate client data to fit each context.
Increasingly, help build the "last mile" that makes deployments scale: automations, API-based integrations, lightweight prototypes, and AI where it adds real value.
Ensure clean, reliable data as the foundation for measurable outcomes.
Industrial expertise
Apply extensive industrial knowledge to tailor deployments to each manufacturing setting.
Promote industry best practices and standards to enhance efficiency and adoption.
Visit client sites in France and abroad (2 to 3 times a month, for 2 to 3 days each) for on-site support and insight.

Why join us

A central, end-to-end role: you're the conductor of the deployment, from signature to lasting adoption. Strategic and empowering.
Direct exposure to senior industrial stakeholders (plant and operations directors, group level) in demanding, stimulating environments.
A pivotal moment: a fast-scaling company moving to an AI-native platform, with real autonomy to shape how we deploy.

How we take care of you

Health insurance: Alan Purple, 100% covered for you
Lunch: Swile meal vouchers
Flexible remote: 3-days office + 3 full remote weeks a year
Time off: RTT
You'll travel, and we've got you covered: SNCF Advantage card reimbursed.
Team life: offices in central Paris (Montmartre), an annual offsite, and monthly afterworks after the All-Hands.

Profil recherché

What You Have

5+ years in B2B SaaS deployment, implementation, or technical consulting (an industrial context is a plus).
Excellent client and stakeholder management; structured, autonomous, with strong ownership.
Engineering degree or technical background.
Comfort with data and a genuine appetite for automation and AI.
Good knowledge of the industrial / manufacturing sector.
Fluent French and English.

Nice to have

Spanish is a strong plus
No-code tools (Make, n8n, Lovable ...)

Process de recrutement

We want your recruitment experience to be positive and transparent. The steps:

15-min HR call: a first chat about your background and motivation.
Interview with Léa, Head of Implementation.
On-site case study + team fit: a hands-on scenario, then a debrief together.
Final interview with Adrien, our CEO.
Reference call.

Our commitments throughout: accessibility
(tell us if you need any adjustments), feedback
at every stage, and flexibility
on interview scheduling.

We are an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Date de début : 01 novembre 2026
Lieu : Paris
Niveau d'études : Bac +3
Expérience : > 5 ans
Télétravail partiel possible

jobs.title: Business analyst
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company renowned for its diverse portfolio of over 150 owned, licensed, and partner brands that cater to a wide range of consumer needs and occasions. The company's North American segment holds prominent positions across categories such as carbonated soft drinks, water, juice, and mixers, featuring iconic brands including Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, 7UP, Snapple, Clamato, and Core Hydration. Globally, KDP's coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the well-known Keurig single-serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with leading brands like Peet's, L'OR, and Jacobs. With a dedicated team of over 50,000 employees, KDP is committed to enhancing every beverage and coffee experience while making positive impacts on communities and the environment. The company emphasizes innovation, growth, and a culture of empowerment, striving to be an employer of choice that supports the health, wellness, and professional development of its workforce.

About The Role

The Engineering Program Manager at Keurig Dr Pepper is a pivotal role within the Multisite Engineering team, responsible for leading the development and execution of manufacturing engineering strategies across multiple production sites. This is a remote position, with an expectation to travel approximately 50% of the time, primarily to operations in the US Northeast, West Coast, and limited international locations. The role involves managing capital projects for 6 to 8 non-carbonated soft drink and food manufacturing facilities, focusing on optimizing productivity, enhancing value, and fostering growth through strategic project implementation.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in developing and executing capital projects within manufacturing environments, particularly in the Food and Beverage or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) sectors. Knowledge of high-speed filling, packaging equipment, aseptic technologies, and plant production lines is highly desirable. The role requires building and maintaining strong relationships with internal teams, external suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery from conception through startup. The Program Manager will also work closely with manufacturing sites to develop, modify, and implement equipment and support devices aligned with capacity and program initiatives, ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and operational standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Chemical Engineering.
Minimum of 8 years of experience managing capital engineering projects, preferably in manufacturing settings.
Proven track record in managing projects with budgets ranging from $100,000 to $25 million.
PMP certification or demonstrated ability to obtain certification within 12 months of employment.
Hands-on experience with manufacturing technologies including carbonated soft drinks, juices, teas, aseptic systems, fillers, cappers, conveyance systems, packers, palletizers, control systems, reverse osmosis, and Batch/CIP systems.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment and travel extensively as required.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and execution of capital projects from initial concept through to startup, ensuring seamless vertical integration and operational readiness.
Define project performance criteria, develop detailed timelines, estimate capital budgets, and oversee project expenditures to stay within financial targets.
Make data-driven, methodical decisions critical to project success, utilizing analytics and performance metrics.
Identify opportunities for cost savings and implement programs across the network to support productivity and efficiency goals.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon is investing heavily in building a world class advertising business and we are responsible for defining and delivering a collection of self-service performance advertising products that drive discovery and sales. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily and are breaking fresh ground to create world-class products. This role will see you collaborate with a large number of teams across WW Advertising to drive key initiatives to improve resilience of advertising systems, take the lead on driving design for large scale critical systems and work with the retail and AWS to drive cross org initiatives.

This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. You constantly strive to expand our understanding of the metrics that drive our business and growth aspirations. 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of software development experience

Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Fleet Operations & Reliability
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About The Role

CoreWeave is building the world's largest AI Cloud platform, and our fleet is growing at extraordinary speed. We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own fleet-wide reliability and operations programs that keep pace with that growth. This role partners closely with Compute, Networking, Data Center, and Operations teams to drive improvements in fleet operating efficiency — maximizing the percentage of fleet capacity that is healthy, available, and sellable — alongside reliability and stability goals.

You'll act as the central owner for fleet reliability and operations programs: aligning teams on priorities, defining success metrics, driving execution, and ensuring improvements hold at scale — not just land once and regress as the fleet scales.

The Technical Program Manager will

Establish and own fleet reliability metrics and dashboards (e.g., failure rates, MTTR, incident trends, capacity availability and utilization rates), with visibility into how these trend as the fleet expands
Drive alignment on fleet reliability OKRs across engineering and operations teams
Identify systemic reliability gaps across hardware, firmware, software, networking, storage, and operational processes
Lead complex, cross-functional programs to improve fleet delivery, readiness, and operational stability that scale with fleet growth, avoiding solutions that only work at current size
Define program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success criteria for reliability initiatives
Proactively manage cross-team dependencies and unblock execution across multiple engineering organizations
Track progress against goals, surface risks early, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders and leadership
Participate in major incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring follow-up actions are tracked to closure
Use data and post-incident learnings to prioritize reliability investments and drive corrective action

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
7+ years of technical program management experience in large-scale compute infrastructure, cloud, or platform environments
Experience operating in a rapidly growing or fast-scaling infrastructure environment, with programs designed to hold up under 2x, 5x, or greater fleet growth
Strong technical aptitude across infrastructure domains (compute, storage, networking, hardware, or SRE)
Demonstrated ability to use data and metrics to drive prioritization, execution, and decision-making
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level reporting

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating at scale in data center, cloud infrastructure, or hyperscale environments balancing reliability investments against capacity goals, with an understanding of how operational decisions affect sellable capacity
Familiarity with reliability frameworks such as SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management practices, and root cause analysis
Understanding of hardware failure and processes, including failure diagnosis, vendor coordination, and replacement lifecycle management
Background in observability, monitoring, or telemetry systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
Experience with fleet lifecycle management (provisioning, firmware/OS updates, decommissioning) at scale

LOCATION: Remote (Open across PST or EST)

The Energy and Sustainability organization drives the company's clean energy strategy and the reporting that underpins Net Zero commitments. The Clean and Renewable Energy (CaRE) team is hiring a Program Manager on a contingent, limited-term basis. During this period, this role serves as the day-to-day owner and coordinator for energy activity data — the Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 energy datasets that feed the company's greenhouse gas (GHG) inventory, emissions forecasting, and voluntary and regulatory disclosures. This is a hands-on, data-centric role: it requires 3-5 years of experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, direct experience working with large datasets and running or QC'ing analytics, and the ability to communicate data status and insights to technical and non-technical audiences. jobs.title: Project Manager - Enterprise Solutions
jobs.description:
Hermanson Company
is a standout Mechanical company that has been doing business in the Puget Sound area since 1979. Over the last four decades we have grown from a family owned sheet metal contractor to a partner led full service mechanical construction, design and maintenance provider playing a significant role in the U.S. national construction industry.

By design, Hermanson is a special place to work. Our belief is that people do business with people they like. In keeping with that belief, we strive to hire and retain highly motivated people who are professional, ethically unwavering, and unrelenting in delivering quality results. We are focused on providing a workplace where high performance individuals come together to build dedicated teams driven to accomplish great things for our customers.

People love working at Hermanson, because we all share the same Core Values:

Clients First – Caring, win-win, value, quality and service attitude
Family Matters - Safety, wellness, stability, enjoyment and balance
Character Matters – Integrity, accountability, passionate, and caring
Team - Trust, honesty, respect, reliable and inclusive
Appreciate – Each other, our successes, and enjoy the journey
Learn, Grow, Innovate – Challenge the status quo and always compete

The Role

Hermanson Company is a fast-growing specialty mechanical contractor building out an integrated, cloud-based, all-in-with-Microsoft platform to put information in people’s hands and time back in their day. Our Enterprise Solutions team delivers the portfolio of initiatives that make that happen including business process changes, D365 F&O enhancements, Power BI and Fabric reporting, and integrating with Construction Technology solutions in support of the field and shop.

This role owns the delivery of projects typically running three to nine months, span multiple functions, and are executed by a small internal team plus occasional outside partners. You will collaborate with an array of cross-functional stakeholders to deliver focused results. Our initiatives run the gauntlet from shop fabrication to field operations, across HR, accounting, and finance and anywhere in between.

Responsibilities

End-to-end delivery. Take assigned initiatives from charter through go-live, adoption, and closeout. Define the scope, gameplan the work, identify what must be true for it to succeed, and see it through.
Planning that holds up. Build and maintain realistic roadmaps and one-page schedules that leadership can digest. Update the plan honestly when reality changes and communicate revisions to leadership early.
Risk and issue management. Surface problems early, while there is still time to mitigate or act on them at low cost. When you escalate, bring options and a recommendation.
Scope discipline. Maintain agreed-to scope, run change requests through a clear decision path, and determine the cost and schedule impact of added requests before they are absorbed into the project.
Partner and budget management. Manage outside vendors against their statement of work: deliverable acceptance, hours against estimate, and evaluation of change orders.
Cross-functional coordination. Engage business SMEs, IT, finance, and operations resources so the right people are in the room at the right time. Come prepared, use their time wisely, and produce living work-products.
Reporting and communication. Provide regular, plainly stated statuses to the Enterprise Solutions lead and business capability owners. Facts are valued over status theater.
Value confirmation. Partner with Hermanson’s business analyst and business process owners to define success measures up front, then come back after deployment and confirm the expected benefits were delivered.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 to $150,000. (The compensation offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills and experience).

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, engineering, construction management, or a related field - or equivalent experience.
5+ years managing business and process improvement projects, with a track record of initiatives you personally drove from ambiguity to an adopted result. Enhancing capabilities across people, processes, information, and systems
Experience building a project’s delivery structure rather than inheriting it: you build your own plan, chase your own dependencies, and adjust the approach based on project needs.
Enough technical literacy to hold your own with developers, data engineers, and partner consultants without writing code. You can follow an integration discussion, read a data flow diagram, and push back on an estimate that does not add up.
Comfortable with modern work-tracking tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, MS Project, or similar) and skilled with Excel.
Crisp written and verbal communication skills across all levels of the organization - from field foremen to functional managers to our c-level executives.
Genuine follow-through. You close loops, follow up until open items are closed and decisions are made - keeping the work moving without falling through the cracks.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in construction, specialty trades, manufacturing, or another project-based business.
Experience with D365 Finance & Operations or Microsoft Dynamics AX.
Familiarity with the Microsoft stack around the ERP: Power BI, Power Platform, Fabric, Azure DevOps.
PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or comparable certification.
Demonstrated use of AI tools to work faster or better in a real-world environment.
Demonstrated delivery of AI solutions that are effective, scalable, and secure in a production environment.

Our Interview Process

Our process includes several conversations with the Enterprise Solutions lead, members of the team, and business stakeholders you would work with. We will ask you to follow a STAR-story interview approach as you walk us through project that did not go as planned: what you noticed first, when you raised it, what you changed, and what you would do differently.

How the Role Starts

You will pick up an initiative already in flight and add others throughout the year. Early on, expect time with stakeholders to understand how the work runs before planning around it. By the end of the year, you would typically be carrying three or four initiatives at different stages.

Location and Work Arrangement

This position is fully remote and open to candidates anywhere in the United States. Our headquarters is in Kent, Washington, with core collaboration hours of 7AM – 3PM PT (10AM – 6PM ET). Occasional travel to Kent is expected, roughly once a year for planning sessions or a major go live.

Hermanson offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial future, and professional growth.

Competitive pay with bonus opportunities
Medical, prescription, dental & vision coverage with zero to low weekly premiums
401(k) with discretionary company match
Generous paid time off (vacation, sick time, and paid holidays)
Disability income protection
Life insurance for employees and eligible dependents
Optional added protection with critical illness and accident plans
Career growth & development opportunities
In-house training programs
Certificate & tuition reimbursement
Wellness program
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Research
new_jobs.description:
About FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists

We’re building AI systems at the frontier of scientific discovery, which means research is fundamental to our product advantage. But great research is not just about generating interesting ideas, it’s about directing our time, talent, and compute toward the work most likely to create meaningful scientific and product progress.

This role exists to bring strong product discipline to research execution. You’ll help researchers turn open-ended exploration into clearly framed bets, define how we measure progress and ROI, and create the operating rhythms that let us learn quickly. You’ll push promising work forward with urgency, surface weak signals early, and help teams change direction when an approach is no longer earning its investment.

Your impact will help Research maximize its pace in the organization - more ambitious in what it pursues, more rigorous in how it evaluates progress, and accountable for turning research investment into real product capabilities and breakthroughs.

What You’ll Do

Partner with research leads to define clear research programs, priorities, hypotheses, milestones, and expected outcomes
Operationalize and steward our Research Portfolio & ROI Framework - assessing research bets by ambition, uncertainty, impact, maturity, time horizon, confidence, cost, and product applicability at the program and portfolio level
Establish stage-appropriate evidence plans, KPIs, and leading and lagging indicators for research projects, including signals that increase or reduce confidence, validate progress, or decisively kill a direction
Create operating rhythms that increase the pace of Research: regular reviews, clear owners, intermediate deliverables, decision points, and tight follow-through
Track research initiatives against their objectives and investment, keeping teams accountable for progress while preserving room for genuine scientific exploration
Identify stalled projects, weak assumptions, and diminishing returns early, and drive explicit decisions to iterate, redirect, pause, or stop work rather than allowing projects to drift
Connect research priorities to company, product, and technical strategy, ensuring the research portfolio reflects the capabilities and differentiated advantages we most need to build
Translate research progress into clear decisions, implications, and tradeoffs for Product, Engineering, and leadership, while helping successful research transition into product capabilities, assets, or future strategic options

Who You Are

5+ years as a product manager or program manager in technology or research organizations, comfortable operating in highly technical, ambiguous, and exploratory environments
Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related technical field; ensuring you can comfortably debate technical tradeoffs.
Deep understanding of program management craft and practices, with the ability to guide ambiguous technical programs, make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and apply product thinking where useful without constraining scientific exploration.
Strong bias toward action and learning velocity, where you look for the fastest credible path to determining whether an idea deserves greater investment
Comfortable holding highly technical teams accountable for commitments, decisions, and outcomes while earning trust through intellectual curiosity and sound judgment
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with a remote-first team.
Motivated by building a research culture that combines scientific ambition with urgency, focus, accountability, and a relentless desire to learn faster

What You’ll Get

The opportunity to work on foundational problems at the intersection of AI and physics
A high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment with real ownership
Remote-first work with flexibility in how you structure your day
Exposure to cutting-edge ideas across AI, scientific discovery, and emerging technologies
A culture that values curiosity, depth of thinking, and first-principles reasoning
The chance to contribute to work aimed at advancing fundamental science

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (ITS & Authoring Systems)
new_jobs.description:
Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction. Using a research-based, personalized approach, Cambium Learning Group delivers SaaS resources and instructional products that engage students and support teachers in fun, positive, safe and scalable environments. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond.

Job Overview

We are seeking an energetic, highly curious Senior Technical Project Manager (TPM) to manage the delivery and strategic evolution of our content authoring platforms. This person acts as a critical point of contact for project delivery, combining a software development management background with deep data literacy. Moving beyond traditional tracking, this role directly contributes to the system roadmap, shapes technical requirements, and drives technical discussions alongside engineering leads. Additionally, this role serves as the primary technical liaison with external vendors and state partners, leading discussions around system integrations, interoperability, and assessment technology standards.

Job Responsibilities

Roadmap Contribution & Technical Design Leadership

Manage roadmap: Work closely with the Technical Directors and engineering leads to actively contribute to the system roadmap, assessing technical feasibility and infrastructure scaling needs of AI and non-AI software projects.
Facilitate design discussions: Facilitate and guide technical design discussions, asking critical questions to help developers hash out complex logic blockages.
Author technical requirements: Distill high-level business goals into detailed technical specifications and API boundary definitions.
Proactively manage roadblocks: Identify structural technical risks early, mitigate system constraints, and drive key technology choices.

External Technical Communications & Interoperability

Manage external tech communications: Serve as the primary technical interface for external organizations, state educational agencies, and client integration teams.
Lead data interoperability: Own technical discussions surrounding cross-platform data exchange, focusing heavily on secure integrations and standardized data pipelines.
Enforce edtech standards: Oversee the implementation of core educational data frameworks and ecosystem standards (e.g., QTI).
Align external vendor APIs: Establish clear technical data mappings and interface requirements with third-party vendors to guarantee plug-and-play platform compatibility.

Technical Analysis & Production Triage

Investigate runtime anomalies: Triage complex backend system issues by analyzing underlying data flows and systemic impacts.
Execute root-cause analysis: Perform deep-dive evaluations on production failures and compile post-incident reports.
Query relational databases: Write custom SQL Server scripts from scratch to extract, validate, and isolate data errors.
Deconstruct error logs: Review application and server logs to track down persistent bugs or data pipeline failures.

Deployment & Configuration Control

Manage release windows: Oversee system deployments and operational maintenance windows alongside DevOps and SRE teams.
Enforce quality control: Partner directly with QA engineers throughout the development lifecycle to maintain execution standards.
Optimize knowledge bases: Structure Confluence repositories to ensure reference materials are searchable and accurate.

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technology-focused discipline.
Experience: Minimum 7+ years of experience in technical project management (or Master's degree with 5+ years), including:
Management background: 5+ years directly managing software engineers, executing hands-on software development, or leading technical system design.
Analysis background: 2+ years operating within data analysis, product support, or technical coordination roles.

Interoperability Literacy: Familiarity with modern data transmission protocols, RESTful APIs, webhooks, and secure data-sharing frameworks.
Database proficiency: Proficient hands-on capability writing relational SQL Server scripts from scratch to analyze datasets.
Technical literacy: Solid understanding of back-end application architecture, web application interactions, and automated data flows.
Delivery execution: Demonstrated capability tracking large-scale engineering lifecycles from planning through deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

AI & Machine Learning Literacy: Strong conceptual understanding of AI foundational components (e.g., Large Language Models, generative workflows, vector search) to confidently support upcoming AI-driven platform expansions.
AI Tooling Efficiency: Hands-on proficiency using AI productivity tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or automated project management workflows) to accelerate technical writing and delivery metrics.
EdTech Interoperability: Direct experience configuring, testing, or launching integrations utilizing the QTI framework.
Domain curiosity: Strong desire to get hands dirty learning the multilayered mechanics of complex educational software applications.
Incident management: Prior experience working in high-pressure production support, site reliability, or incident management environments.

To apply for this opportunity, simply click on the “Apply” button and submit a cover letter and resume.

Job Summary

Run the execution engine of a technology team built for the AI era, not a status-report treadmill. You execute and provide visibility across every IT project at DW1: development sprints, integrations (Salesforce and similar), and special projects. Most distinctively, you run the readiness smoke test, the quality gate every requirement passes before design or build.

You'll partner with a Business Process Lead who owns what the business needs and why. You will own and report on how and when projects get delivered. Our pipeline is spec-driven and AI-assisted: AI coding agents augment development efforts with human approval and feedback loops, and the discipline you enforce at the front is what makes the agents behind it effective.

Write requirements and testable acceptance criteria ("When X, the system shall Y") before any code exists, consulting the Business Process Lead on intent. Your criteria are consumed by engineers, QA, and AI agents alike.

Sequence and plan all IT project work in Jira and Monday: sprints, capacity lanes, and dependencies.
Own intake: a published path for how work gets requested, prioritized, and answered, so nothing reaches developers through side channels.
Build and maintain delivery dashboards reported every sprint: cycle time, escaped defects, release validation time, support interrupts.
Own change management and stakeholder communication: rollouts, cutovers, and retrospectives that examine where work waited, not just what shipped.

Qualifications

4-8 years running software or IT project delivery, ideally in enterprise, ERP, logistics, or operational software. Spec-driven development experience is a plus.

The ability to hold a quality gate with senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know a real emergency from a loud request.

Fluency with Jira or equivalent (Azure DevOps), sprint planning, and release management.

Change management experience: rollouts, cutovers, and keeping the business informed without drama.

Curiosity about AI-assisted delivery

new_jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Nice to haves:

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

new_jobs.title: Manager Enablement, Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Toast

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Role Overview

The Manager Enablement Program Manager is the strategic architect responsible for enabling, scaling, and governing the holistic onboarding, continuous development, and coaching infrastructure for people managers globally across Customer Care and Customer Success (CS). This senior individual contributor role defines how Toast builds its leadership bench and empowers managers to transform talent into high-performing contributors within a complex operational ecosystem.

Serving as a thought leader within the Enablement organization and a trusted partner to Care and CS Directors and Senior Leaders, this role bridges the gap between leadership development and business-critical KPIs. By applying advanced data analytics, adult learning principles, and modern AI tools, you will build a predictable, scalable ecosystem that equips managers to drive consistent team performance across key metrics such as CSAT, and Net Revenue Retention. This role will guide managers through the governance of high velocity tech changes to policy, procedure, and platforms to ensure high adoption and clear post enablement impact.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Strategic Program Management & Governance

Design, contract, and scale end-to-end Manager Training & Enablement programs aimed at robust bench building, leadership development, and continuous professional growth.
Partner with Care Operations, CS and CSO leadership to shape the overall manager investment strategy bringing consensus and acquiring buy-in to a shared vision and roadmap.
Build and govern standardized coaching playbooks, behavioral rubrics, and coaching certifications to ensure global manager consistency and talent transformation.
Establish operational rhythms and governance frameworks that empower managers to effectively leverage insights tools and drive high-impact coaching sessions with AI based manager 1:1 dashboards and transcription analysis.

AI Coaching Modules & Ecosystem Innovation

Architect and transition the standard manager training lifecycle into a closed-loop system by designing, piloting, and scaling autonomous AI coaching modules and simulation systems.
Integrate AI voice and text-based role-play tools into a manager "practice arena" to simulate high-complexity coaching, performance management, and alignment scenarios to assist managers with the development of their direct reports.
Optimize modern AI tools and LLM-based tech to build engaging, hyper-personalized manager support tools that empower leaders to be highly effective.

Tailored Enablement Delivery & Architecture

Develop specialized, distinct enablement pathways that address the priority KPIs of Customer Care (TTR/C (Time to Resolve/Close), CSAT (Customer Satisfaction), Transfer Rate, and AHT (Average Handle Time)) and CSM KPIs (Save Rate, Churn Mitigation, Downsell prevention).
Drive key manager KPIs in Coaching Compliance, Coaching Effectiveness, and Manager Engagement.
Design, build, and iterate on the onboarding design for new managers, including newly promoted, as well as the continuous development and enablement of tenured managers.
Ensure managers are deeply versed on organizational, product, and process changes, and fully equipped to translate those changes effectively to their teams during Huddles and dedicated coaching sessions to ensure adoption and effective application by their agents.

Influence, Analytics & Evaluation

Align and influence cross-functional Senior Leader and Director-level stakeholders as a trusted thought partner, managing massive programmatic changes across distributed teams.
Proactively identify global areas of opportunity to support managers and leadership, providing ready solutions backed by a high rigor of analytical and performance assessment.
Lead as a Center of Excellence globally, evaluating behavioral opportunity areas and structuring remedial manager initiatives both internally as well as shared with BPO partners.
Establish robust post-enablement measurement frameworks to evaluate learning impact, leveraging AI analytics to track real-world performance improvements and core business KPIs.

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

5-8 years of experience delivering high-impact enablement, training infrastructure, leadership development curriculum, or performance coaching strategies within a fast-paced SaaS, Fintech, or fast-growth tech environment.
Demonstrated ability as a senior leader to align cross-functional VP and Director-level stakeholders, manage massive programmatic changes, and drive process discipline across fragmented teams.
Proven domain expertise navigating both transactional/queue-based operational environments (Customer Care/Support) and relationship-driven commercial environments (Customer Success/Account Management).
A strong portfolio of work demonstrating the ability to take an ambiguous, loosely defined objective and turn it into a scalable, repeatable corporate program.
Bachelor’s degree required, with an advanced degree in Adult Learning, Organizational Development, or a related discipline highly preferred.
Power-user familiarity with modern customer stacks, learning tools, and data analytics dashboards (e.g., Salesforce, CRMs, LMS tools, and AI platform assistants).

Nice to Haves

Ability to leverage AI technology to deliver and measure proven learning impact, moving beyond traditional completion rates to extract deep leader performance insights.
Proven ability to leverage AI to analyze complex leadership learning opportunities, recommend and gain buy-in on the right solution for complicated business needs, and follow through to completion.
Prior experience managing managers and coaching coaches, as a force multiplier across a multi-team organization.
Prior experience working within the restaurant and/or tech space, or a deep personal understanding of restaurant operations and hospitality.
Self-motivated disposition with a relentless "fixer" mindset—the ability to see the big picture and solve root-cause problems rather than immediate symptoms.
Project management certifications (such as PMP or PMO framework familiarity) or a proven track record of applying formal project management methodologies to scale complex enablement lifecycles.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented program managers, you can decide where a career in Prime Video Tech takes you!

We are seeking a Vendor Program Manager to support our Media Digital Supply Chain operations. This role will serve as a key point of contact between Prime Video and our media fulfillment vendor and posthouse network, driving operational excellence, supporting innovation adoption, and contributing to the optimization of our digital supply chain ecosystem.

This individual will contribute to the evolution of our digital supply chain architecture, with a passion to learn, innovate, and solve complex problems. As a Vendor Program Manager, you will be responsible for managing vendor relationships and executing programs that drive efficiency and enhance the customer experience.

You will work across cross-functional teams, implement new workflows, and partner with product and technology teams to translate business requirements into operational improvements. The successful candidate should have familiarity with Movie and TV content digital delivery standards, formats, and specifications, along with the ability to acquire new technology concepts quickly.

Key job responsibilities

Vendor Performance Management: Audit and optimize steady-state delivery performance metrics for media fulfillment vendors, aligning priorities and maximizing impact for both Prime Video and our vendor partners.

Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Lead comprehensive portfolio strategy across all regions (US, EU, APAC) and services (Fulfillment, Localization, Technology, Accessibility, Aggregation), anticipating and addressing studio and customer needs.

Product Feature Adoption: Facilitate regular connections with vendors to communicate upcoming spec and feature updates, ensuring full understanding, compliance, and adoption of Prime Video technical specifications and product requirements.

Program Roadmap & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prioritize team roadmap and allocate resources effectively across key initiatives, while proactively identifying risks and opportunities to stay ahead of industry trends.

5+ years of Supply Chain, Product Management, Program Management experience
Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions
Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
3+ years of experience in media, entertainment, or digital content industries
Proven track record of managing complex vendor relationships and driving performance improvements

Knowledge of digital file and folder management systems, marketing workflow tools, DAM, and Localization systems
2+ years of driving process improvements experience

Experience representing organizations at industry events and conferences

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA's deep learning platforms are at the forefront of innovation, profoundly impacting various fields and widely adopted by leading academic institutions, startups, and major Internet companies globally. We're seeking an accomplished and highly skilled Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our NVIDIA DGX Cloud team. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, results-oriented, and creative individual to deliver exceptional value to our DGX Cloud customers. We are specifically looking for a TPM with extensive background in cloud infrastructure bring-up with external partners. You will play a key role in collaborating with CSPs, emerging cloud providers and engineering teams internally to help build AI capacity and infrastructure across the globe

What You'll Be Doing

As a DGX Cloud Technical Program Manager, you'll be a key partner to our Engineering, Infrastructure, Software teams and their leadership, driving critical programs related to AI capacity enablement and management. You'll play a pivotal role in developing and maturing foundational capabilities and processes for DGX Cloud, spanning critical areas such as cluster/capacity bring-up including CPU, storage, networking and compute requirements to support GPUs. This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where TPMs are encouraged to apply fungible abilities to a range of high-impact programs within the DGX Cloud ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Working in close coordination with storage engineering and network engineering teams to define and communicate requirements to CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers). Drive alignment and a POR for capacity blocks based on workload needs.
Drive early engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers) to understand their managed storage, network solutions and influence alignment with NVIDIA Cloud roadmap
Gathering technical requirements, developing comprehensive roadmaps, establishing clear milestones, and ensuring adherence to our Product Lifecycle (PLC) process.
Managing ongoing capacity operations and the engineering engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Provider) partners, collaborating closely with engineering leads. Focus on availability, maintenance and other critical performance indicators.
Partner closely within NVIDIA to understand workload requirements and related hardware and infrastructure needs. This includes speeds and feeds to optimize infrastructure readiness with cloud vendors and NVIDIA Cloud Providers.
Leveraging Jira and other program management platforms to instill rigor and structure in the management of engineering deliverables.
Identifying and driving opportunities to onboard the adoption of third-party and in-house cloud infrastructure solutions for deployments, support, security, compliance and observability across DGX Cloud
Establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) and quantitatively demonstrating the value and impact delivered by your programs.
Proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks and issues that could affect scope, schedule, and quality across all program aspects.
Encouraging a culture of continuous improvement, consistently seeing opportunities for process improvements within our cloud infrastructure operations.

What We Need To See

10+ years of technical program management experience. You have driven the planning and execution of large-scale cloud infrastructure programs with outside organizations. You focus strongly on software engineering projects within a matrixed organization.
Extensive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, preferably gained from working at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP).
Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).
Expert-level proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, or similar program management tools, with the ability to expertly guide engineering teams on their use of the tools.
Outstanding strategic and tactical thinking abilities, coupled with a strong capacity to build consensus and drive program success
Comfort and efficiency in growing within ambiguous environments.
Possess excellent communication and technical presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences.
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

In depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up
Working knowledge of various cloud technologies (Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, etc)
A highly enthusiastic, energetic, responsive, and passionate individual with a keen eye for identifying process improvement opportunities.
Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation is a major plus.
Deep familiarity with cloud-native product / services environments and familiarity with AI, ML infrastructure, and cloud/services

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We offer attractive compensation and an extensive benefits package. While planning your future, explore what we provide for you and your loved ones at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Description

What if your job was to prove that an AI-powered idea actually works - in weeks, not years - for the organisations that serve millions of people every day? We're looking for a Technical Program Manager who thrives at the intersection of generative AI, agentic systems, and real-world public sector challenges across Australia and New Zealand. You'll own the delivery of rapid engineering prototypes - most leveraging AI capabilities - that de-risk major technology investments for government agencies, healthcare systems, research institutions, and critical infrastructure providers.

This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination one. You will work side by side with software engineers and solutions architects to scope, plan, build, and ship AI-driven solutions that directly influence multi-million-dollar customer decisions. If you enjoy moving fast, applying generative AI and machine learning to real problems, making architecture and trade-off decisions alongside engineers, and seeing your work in production within weeks - not months - keep reading.

Key job responsibilities

Engagement Ownership

Own delivery of 2–4 concurrent engagements from qualification through build to customer handoff
Translate business problems into prototyping charters with defined outcomes, timelines, and exit criteria
Make architecture and design trade-offs alongside engineers - own the technical outcome, not just the schedule
Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and execution across short build cycles

Pipeline & Qualification

Partner with sales and solutions architects to qualify opportunities against impact and feasibility
Lead Working Backwards workshops to define scope and success metrics

Reuse, Scale & Handover

Architect for reuse across customers, verticals, and geographies; plan handover with transfer artefacts and code drops
Collaborate globally (NAMER, UKGI) to share patterns and adapt solutions across regions

Regulated Environments

Navigate data sovereignty, health privacy, and government security requirements; clear compliance blockers for co-builds involving customer data

Stakeholder Navigation & Impact

Primary interface between customer, account team, and engineering - aligning sales priorities with technical feasibility
Connect prototype outcomes to investment decisions; surface reusable patterns for service teams

Technical Depth

Stay current on AWS AI/ML (Bedrock, SageMaker, agentic frameworks), serverless, and app modernization
Evaluate emerging GenAI, edge AI, and AI-assisted development patterns for public sector applicability

A day in the life

You ship working software - not slide decks. Engagements end with a prototype answering real customer questions.
Variety and pace - AI health assistants one month, legacy modernization the next, in weeks-long cycles.
Technical ownership - design trade-offs alongside engineers; you own the outcome.
Direct impact - prototypes inform multi-million-dollar decisions for organizations serving millions.
Small team, outsized reach - high-autonomy work visible to senior leadership.
Build once, amplify many - solutions reused across countries and showcased at AWS events.
Global team - collaborating across time zones to share patterns and raise the bar.

About The Team

A field-deployed AWS engineering team accelerating public sector outcomes through prototyping - with AI at the core. We build working systems that de-risk transformation programs and unlock cloud adoption for government organizations across Australia and New Zealand.

Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations

new_jobs.title: Program Manager II, North America Transportation
new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we are committed to being the most customer-centric company on earth. The North American Transportation team at Amazon is comprised of high-powered dynamic teams which are shaping network execution through the development and application of innovative transportation and delivery management concepts. The Transportation Execution team within North American Transportation is looking for a Program Manager to lead analysis and execution around volume allocations to all transportation partners. As a Program Manager, this role will be responsible for deep diving transportation cost drivers, and partnering with cross-functional teams to action specific drivers while maintaining or improving customer experience and transportation cost by driving the proper volume allocations to our carriers leading to the most optimized mix. This position will lead programs from the idea inception to implementation, and manage multiple, competing projects, and effectively prioritize them.

Key job responsibilities

Manage new and existing programs, successfully delivering difficult projects and goals across multiple organizations
Work directly with external providers, customers, and partner teams to craft and deliver scalable solutions
Partner with other program managers to secure resources, scope efforts, set project priorities and milestones and drive delivery
Own program communication, accelerating progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, clearing blockers (e.g., path to green), escalating as appropriate
Influence design and development of strategic processes
Work with program managers and business leaders to communicate and impact critical business initiatives
Develop, implement, and govern KPI reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones, and performance across all projects and using this data to drive/influence business decisions
Engage other Amazon business units globally to share best practices and improve end to end outcomes for Amazon customers
Manage post-launch support plans (e.g., post-mortem, issue/ticket management, etc.) and look for opportunities to improve program quality and operational excellence

A day in the life

Understand the North America (NA) Transportation network, act as a subject matter expert for driving changes to the volume mix across all of North America Fulfillment Centers (NAFC)
Work with Long-Term and Mid-Term Planning teams to set volume plans by carrier for future time frames to ensure accuracy and validity of plans while managing for key metrics such as Cost, DEA and Speed
Identify, analyze, and maintain key metrics, with trend and variance analyses to discern root cause of defects
Collaborate with other Program/Product Managers and Analysts to continuously improve operations ability to support volume allocations change and carrier commitment requirement changes
Partner with Carriers (AMZL, Amazon Air, Third Party), Carrier Managers, Finance, Technology teams and ensure network design manages Speed, DEA and Cost effectively and can properly maintain volume allocation targets

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

3+ years of relevant experience, Minimum 3+ years of project management experience

As a SAP Program Manager, you will lead and manage large-scale SAP implementation projects, working closely with business leaders, project managers, and technical teams to define objectives, develop plans, allocate resources, and monitor progress. Managing project resources and timelines to facilitate successful delivery of SAP solutions
